# `foxglove config unset`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](config.md)

```text
Remove a configuration value

Usage: foxglove config unset [OPTIONS] <KEY>

Arguments:
  <KEY>
          [possible values: project-id]

Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]

          [default: false]
```
